The test image shows a soybean leaf with numerous small, dark brown to dark purple/black spots scattered across the upper leaf surface. Some spots have yellow halos. The spots appear irregularly shaped and some are beginning to coalesce. This points primarily to Septoria brown spot.

Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference confirms the pattern: small, dark brown/black spots scattered across the leaf, some with yellow areas. The test image shows the same type of small, numerous dark brown spots on a green leaf, with yellow halos around some lesions — consistent with Septoria brown spot at an earlier/active stage before heavy yellowing.
